description: This file defines the CellAlignment class responsible for mapping numeric alignment codes to corresponding alignment constants and applying these alignments to given Alignment objects in the PHPSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: CellAlignment
classes.description: Provides static methods to set horizontal, vertical, and wrap text alignment properties on Alignment objects based on integer codes.

methods.name: horizontal
methods.description: Sets the horizontal alignment of the Alignment object based on a numeric code.

methods.name: vertical
methods.description: Sets the vertical alignment of the Alignment object based on a numeric code.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Sets the wrap text property of the Alignment object based on a numeric flag.
